title: Transparent Origami
description: Fold a transparent paper with dots to reveal capital letters.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate paper folding by reflecting dot coordinates across fold lines. Use a set of (x, y) positions so overlapping dots merge automatically.

## Part 1

Apply just the first fold instruction. For a fold along `x=V`, any dot with `x > V` maps to `x = 2V - x`. Similarly for `y` folds. Count the remaining unique dots.

## Part 2

Apply all fold instructions sequentially. The final set of dots forms 8 capital letters. Render them on a grid by iterating over the bounding box and printing `#` for dots, spaces for blanks.
